G=[[6,6,6,1,9,6,6,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,6,6,9,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,3,6,6,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,6,7,6,1,6,6,6],
   [1]*11,
   [6,6,6,1,6,6,6,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,6,6,6,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,6,6,6,1,6,6,6],
   [6,6,6,1,6,6,6,1,6,6,6]]
import numpy as np
A=np.array(G)
row_seps=[r for r in range(9) if set(A[r])=={1}]
col_seps=[c for c in range(11) if set(A[:,c])=={1}]
print(row_seps,col_seps)
row_blocks = [r for r in [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8] if r not in row_seps]
# group
def blocks(idx):
    b=[];cur=[idx[0]]
    for i in idx[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: b.append(cur);cur=[i]
    b.append(cur);return b
rb=blocks(row_seps and [i for i in range(9) if i not in row_seps])
cb=blocks([c for c in range(11) if c not in col_seps])
print(rb,cb)
bg=6
strays=[(r,c,A[r,c]) for r in range(9) for c in range(11) if A[r,c] not in (bg,1)]
print(strays)
panel_of={ (bi,bj):(r0,c0) for bi,rows in enumerate(rb) for bj,cols in enumerate(cb) for r0 in [rows[0]] for c0 in [cols[0]]}
def which(r,c):
    return next((bi,bj) for bi,rows in enumerate(rb) for bj,cols in enumerate(cb) if r in rows and c in cols)
out=[row[:] for row in G]
for r,c,v in strays:
    bi,bj=which(r,c)
    lr=r-rb[bi][0]; lc=c-cb[bj][0]
    for bi2 in range(len(rb)):
        for bj2 in range(len(cb)):
            out[rb[bi2][0]+lr][cb[bj2][0]+lc]=v
for row in out: print(row)
